file.title: File
file.description: The Data Map's file the tables are in: source.json or destination.json.

here_key.title: Here Key
here_key.description: The table's key in the Data Map's file, or null when it lacks it.

there_key.title: There Key
there_key.description: Its key in the Database node's schema.json, or null when that lacks it.

status.title: Status
status.description: 'missing_here' (only in the Database node), 'missing_there' (only in the Data Map) or 'differs'.

problem_here.title: Problem Here
problem_here.description: Why the Database node's table can't be copied into the Data Map, or empty.

problem_there.title: Problem There
problem_there.description: Why the Data Map's table can't be copied into the Database node, or empty.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Tables the user said not to ask about again.

links.title: Links
links.description: Each Database node linked to the Data Map. Empty when none is.

404.description: Project, workflow, or node not found
